image_description: A high-angle, slightly distant shot of an ornate church altar. The central focus is a white-clothed table (the mensa) with a floral arrangement and candles. Behind it rises a large, elaborate stone or marble altarpiece (reredos) featuring Gothic-style arches, statues, and painted panels. To the left and right are tall columns with vertical banners depicting religious scenes. The lighting is warm and ambient, typical of a cathedral interior.
